issue_context.title: Format `PatternMatchAs`
issue_context.body:
Implement formatting for `x as ..` pattern

```python
match x:
    case [x] as y:
        ...
    case _:
        ...
```

review_comments: I expect that Black's logic is to preserve parentheses around nested patterns. But we can track this in a separate issue
